about: The colour space's specimen (brand/colour-space.html at 4fa1bed, 2 October 2026) run in Node on the seed acts, the page's examples and seeded random boards, and what it said written down. Made by core/src/colour/test/make-golden.mjs. core/src/colour must say the same: hues to 1e-6, hexes equal. A scenario with an `overflow` is one where the specimen ran out of patterns and repeated the last; core says so instead, so only its colours are held to the golden there.
